purpose.zh: 练肩袖，提升肩外旋力量
purpose.en: Build the rotator cuff and shoulder external rotation.

text.zh: 肘贴在身侧，前臂向上向外转
text.en: Keep your elbow at your side and rotate your forearm up and out
Keep your trunk from rolling back.

text.zh: 顶端停一下，再慢慢放下
text.en: Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Letting the elbow lift away from your side.
Rolling the body back to help.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.
You can hold a water bottle for light resistance.
